fleet.what: `sensor_modeling.health.fleet.common_silences` over the times of each home's delivered observations
fleet.what_it_does_not_test: in `outage` the homes' outages are spread over 18 days, so few homes are silent at once and the fraction is far away. C7 says the check is not tripped by outages that merely overlap, and nothing about where the fraction should be set

silent_home_protocol.check: with the rule off the run must give the published record's 2,850 monitored days and 183 behavioural alerts, or nothing is reported
silent_home_protocol.citation: Palermo, F.; Chen, Y.; Capstick, A.; Fletcher-Lloyd, N.; Walsh, C.; Kouchaki, S.; True, J.; Balazikova, O.; Soreq, E.; Scott, G.; Rostill, H.; Nilforooshan, R.; Barnaghi, P. TIHM: An open dataset for remote healthcare monitoring in dementia. Scientific Data 10, 606 (2023). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02519-y
silent_home_protocol.dataset: TIHM: An Open Dataset for Remote Healthcare Monitoring in Dementia
silent_home_protocol.fleet: the fleet check with the settings above, over the times of each home's activity records
silent_home_protocol.licence: CC BY 4.0; the dataset's repository asks that Surrey and Borders Partnership NHS Foundation Trust and Howz be acknowledged in any publication or use
silent_home_protocol.not_reported: any relation to the dataset's labels. Whether the alerts that remain relate to what a clinical team verified is the alert-burden protocol's question and is not reopened here
reported: the days the baseline refused because of the rule, in all and per home
behavioural alerts, in all and by date
silence alerts, in all and per home
the stretches of common silence the fleet check finds, and the silence alerts dated inside one
silent_home_protocol.standing: a description, not a test: the rule was designed from these homes

conditions.off: the rule off: the pipeline's default

the_rule.horizons: declared, not estimated from any home

inference.label: online filter
inference.provenance: declared by the experiment that wrote the record

inputs.name: alert_burden_protocol.json
inputs.role: frozen alert-burden protocol, whose run the rule is added to

inputs.name: tihm-alert-burden.json
inputs.role: published alert-burden record, which the run with the rule off must reproduce home by home

metric_definitions.behavioural_alert: an alert of kind behavioural_change. It is counted on the day whose summary raised it, which is the alert-burden protocol's alert day, and also on the local date it was raised on, which is the day after
metric_definitions.day_refused_because_of_the_rule: a monitored day part of which fell in a silence of the whole home, which the baseline is therefore not offered
metric_definitions.silence_alert: an alert of kind data_quality about `home_silence`

notes: A description, not a test. The rule was designed from these homes, so what it does to them is not evidence that it works.
No relation to the dataset's labels is reported.
Nothing was fitted on TIHM. Apart from the rule, the run is the alert-burden protocol's.
